Each allocated ton earns $1000. Your goal is to optimize your own income in the long run over many months. At month end, if at least 25 tons remain, a natural replenishment restores stock to 500 with probability75%; otherwise (probability25%) remaining stock doubles, capped at 500. If fewer than 25 tons remain, the fishery collapses to zero. Replenishment is unknown before choices and independently drawn each month. For example, if everyone takes10, 250 remain and next stock is500 under either outcome. Public discussion occurs before this month's private choice.
